title: What is left to decide for the team offsite
lede: Sample data, invented for the kit. The first option is the recommended one. To go fast, accept the recommendations at the bottom and change only the ones you disagree with.

items.title: Which city hosts it?
items.context: Three cities fit the budget. Porto has direct flights for 14 of the 18 people and the cheapest venue quote.
items.tradeoff: Four people need a connection of about two hours.

items.title: Which week?

items.tradeoff: It overlaps with one product launch; that team would join for three days instead of five.
